spec.description: Storage and filesystem diagnostics for Domibus performance testing. Use this dashboard to inspect host capacity, disk throughput, IOPS, latency, busy time, in-progress I/O and container filesystem behavior during a Run.

spec.title: Root Filesystem Used
spec.description: Current utilization of the host root filesystem.

spec.title: Root Filesystem Available
spec.description: Currently available bytes on the host root filesystem.

spec.title: Host Disk Write Throughput
spec.description: Current aggregate host disk write throughput.

spec.title: Host Disk Busy
spec.description: Approximate aggregate disk busy percentage. Values can exceed 100% when multiple block devices are active.

spec.title: Domibus FS Write Throughput
spec.description: Current filesystem write throughput for the Domibus containers.

spec.title: Domibus FS Usage
spec.description: Current cAdvisor-reported filesystem usage attributed to the Domibus container.

spec.title: Filesystem Utilization
spec.description: Utilization of relevant host filesystems; pseudo/temporary filesystems are excluded.

spec.title: Filesystem Available Space
spec.description: Available capacity on relevant host filesystems.

spec.title: Filesystem Inode Utilization
spec.description: Inode utilization on relevant host filesystems.

spec.title: Filesystem Read-Only State
spec.description: 0 = writable, 1 = read-only. Unexpected transitions are critical for payload delivery.

spec.title: Host Disk Throughput
spec.description: Aggregate host block-device read/write throughput.

spec.title: Host Disk IOPS
spec.description: Completed host block-device operations per second.

spec.title: Host Average I/O Time
spec.description: Average service time per completed host read/write operation.

spec.title: Host Disk Busy Time
spec.description: Per-device percentage of time spent servicing I/O.

spec.title: Host I/O In Progress
spec.description: Number of I/O operations currently in progress per block device.

spec.title: Host Weighted I/O Time
spec.description: Rate of weighted I/O time; useful as a queue-pressure indicator when latency rises.

spec.title: Container Filesystem Throughput
spec.description: Filesystem read/write throughput for selected containers.

spec.title: Container Filesystem IOPS
spec.description: Filesystem read/write operation rate for selected containers.

spec.title: Container I/O In Progress
spec.description: Current filesystem I/O operations in progress for selected containers.

spec.title: Container I/O Time
spec.description: Seconds of container filesystem I/O time accumulated per second.

spec.title: Container Filesystem Usage
spec.description: cAdvisor-reported filesystem usage for selected containers.

spec.title: Container Inode Utilization
spec.description: Approximate inode utilization attributed to selected containers.

spec.title: 04 — Domibus · Storage & Filesystem
